sources.title: Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated: Text-to-Text model — overview, use ...
sources.snippet: Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated is an uncensored version of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B created using abliteration, a technique that removes refusal mechanisms from language models without requiring TransformerLens. Developed by huihui-ai, this model retains the first 15 layers without ablation while modifying deeper layers to eliminate safety constraints.

sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen3.8: Qwen3.8 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Welcome to the GitHub repository of the Qwen3.5 open model series, including Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and the latest Qwen3.8. Here, you can find official information about Qwen3.8, post your questions (Issues), and share your ideas with the community (Discussions).

sources.title: Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated launches as an uncensored AI model for free
sources.snippet: The model also supports thinking mode, accepts both text and images, and offers a 262,000-token context window. It can be run through Ollama with the command `ollama run huihui_ai/Qwen3.8-abliterated`. For deployment, the card recommends using the latest version of Ollama, and the model is also listed on Ollama as another place to try it.
